'''Osaf Hamud''' was [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] scholar who wrote a document about [[orbalisk]]s. He came up with the one solution on how to remove the dangerous parasites. His paper, titled ''[[An Examination and Exploration of a Most Dangerous and Resilient Organism]]'', was on record in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. In [[990 BBY]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], disguised as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], discovered this essay while searching for a solution to how her master, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], could remove the orbalisks stuck to his body.
